comment: The 11 official US federal holidays, in nextOccurrence()-compatible shape ({month,day} fixed date, or {month,nth,weekday} nth-weekday, nth:-1 = last). `observed:true` marks fixed-date holidays subject to the standard federal Sat->Fri / Sun->Mon observed-date shift; nth-weekday holidays are always Monday already and Thanksgiving is always Thursday, so neither needs it. Used by seo/tools/build-microevents.mjs for /next-federal-holiday/ and /next-long-weekend/ — kept separate from events.json (which carries full SEO/page content per holiday) since this is pure date data.
